product.description:
Built around one thing - Balance! The sole in Stabilon Sneakers is shaped such that your foot rolls naturally, keeping it steady, heel to toe, with each step, instead of landing flat. Good for commuting, travel days, even morning walks, and especially for days that keep you on your feet longer than you planned.

  • Sole Material: Rubber/EVA (Ethylene Vinyl Acetate) 
  • Closure Type: Lace-up
  • Shoe Size Width: Wide
  • Toe Style: Closed Toe
  • Arch Type: Low Arch
  • Water-Resistant: No
  • Shoe Height: Low-Top
